items.title: Connect a real charger through ocpp.voltaracharging.com
items.notes: Charger 123456 is registered on staging (Open security). Enter the address and ID on the unit, confirm boot, status and a full charging session.

items.title: Merge PR #3
items.notes: Open-charger credentials fix, one-row status board, place search for locations, this roadmap board.

items.title: Decide how chargers are named
items.notes: Names were removed: operators see the charge point ID and serial, drivers see the car park lot. Research pending on whether a suggested display name is still wanted.

items.title: Live session card per gun on the charger page
items.notes: kW now, kWh, battery %, elapsed time, cost so far and driver, with a small power graph. Replaces the stale status table other platforms show.

items.title: Driver app MVP (Phase 4)
items.notes: Sign-in, charger map and list with live availability, start and stop, live session screen, history. Scaffold and driver access layer exist.

items.title: Logs: date range and download
items.notes: The timeline already pairs requests with replies and filters by session. Add a custom date range and a CSV/JSON download for vendor tickets.

items.title: Configuration: key settings in plain language
items.notes: Heartbeat, meter interval and similar at the top of the Configuration tab, with recommended values.

items.title: Configuration templates per charger model
items.notes: A recommended baseline applied at boot, and a warning when a charger drifts from it.

items.title: Availability: reason and pending state
items.notes: Record why a gun was taken out of service; show "takes effect after the session" when the charger answers Scheduled.

items.title: Remote start for app drivers and billing accounts
items.notes: Remote start can only pick an RFID card today.

items.title: Optional label per gun
items.notes: Override the automatic letter (A, B) where the sticker on the unit says something else; max 30 characters so it can form the roaming EVSE ID.

items.title: Show the car park lot on session screens
items.notes: Needs a narrow read permission so a driver can see the gun used in their own session.

items.title: Directions buttons: Google Maps and Waze
items.notes: Use the shared mapLinks helper and each site's pin.

items.title: Staging label in the admin
items.notes: A visible marker when the admin is connected to staging, so it is not mistaken for the local demo.

items.title: Start the staging admin with pnpm dev
items.notes: Port 5174 currently needs starting by hand after a codespace restart.

items.title: Charger bolt icon in the driver app
items.notes: Replace the yellow emoji bolt with the drawn icon used in the admin.

items.title: Power limit per charger
items.notes: SetChargingProfile from the admin: typed limit in kW or A, optional schedule, accepted/rejected feedback, and the limit currently in force.

items.title: Site load management
items.notes: Share a building's capacity across its chargers automatically. The condo selling point: avoids TNB maximum-demand charges.

items.title: Payments (Phase 5)
items.notes: Stripe: cards, FPX, GrabPay; per-tenant Connect. DuitNow QR guest checkout. Needs the tax and BNM opinion first.

items.title: SST and BNM opinion
items.notes: Malaysian tax and legal opinion; required before payments go live.

items.title: Pre-production review
items.notes: Strong staging password and two-factor sign-in, branch protection on main, production Supabase project and Fly app, admin deploy (Cloudflare secrets), leaked-password protection.

items.title: White-label and onboarding (Phase 6)
items.notes: Tenant self-serve onboarding, theme provider, tenant switcher, platform-admin console, production project.

items.title: Firmware updates
items.notes: UpdateFirmware with progress tracking and staged rollout.

items.title: Diagnostics upload
items.notes: GetDiagnostics for vendor support tickets.

items.title: Offline RFID list
items.notes: SendLocalList so residents' cards work when a basement charger loses its connection.

items.title: Fault alerts
items.notes: Plain-language vendor error codes, automatic issues, "offline for more than X minutes" notifications.

items.title: Bulk actions
items.notes: Reset, apply configuration or update firmware across many chargers.

items.title: OCPP 2.0.1 adapter
items.notes: A second adapter onto the same domain model; decide how gun letters map to EVSE numbers.

items.title: OCPI roaming
items.notes: CPO module; EVSE IDs built from the gun label.

items.title: MEVnet / ST reporting exports
items.notes: Full reporting; a first export stub exists.

items.title: Singapore support
items.notes: Country on sites, no Malaysian state, local licensing rules.

items.title: Merge the Voltara Home app
items.notes: Parked in archive/home-app. Homeowner experience into the driver app, staff portal into the admin, schema reconciled by new migrations.

items.title: Capture the HiCi Bluetooth protocol
items.notes: The archived protocol layer is a guess; bench capture needed before it talks to real units.

items.title: Production charger catalogue
items.notes: Curate real brands and models; today's list is dev data.

items.title: Real tariffs as golden test cases
items.notes: Voltara's actual tariffs in the cost-engine tests.

items.title: Place search provider decision
items.notes: Stay on OpenStreetMap or move to Google Places (needs a billed key).
